contract_owner.role: read-only source, units, domain, quantifier, theorem-interface, and claim-ceiling framing

required_proof_connections: Reuse the reviewed actual right-sided IR limit; do not reprove it.
Prove the small-energy pointwise bound and a separate explicit UV bound with all positive denominators established before division.
Split the radial integral near zero and in the exponential tail; a formal series alone is insufficient.
Use the actual product measure with finite angular measure and an almost-everywhere measurable polynomial kernel bound.
Prove both the direct density integrability and its withDensity weighted-measure formulation.
The mixture is a probability measure over states with beta>=b and eta<=0 almost everywhere; prove the reference envelope independently.

Prove 0<T<=Tmax and kB>0 imply inverseTemperature(kB,Tmax)<=inverseTemperature(kB,T); specialize beta(s) to this inverse temperature under the same a.e. state assumptions, retaining the occupation-integrability premise.
No separate condensate atom is admitted by the definitions; do not claim a physical condensate-exclusion theorem.
Do not infer b or Tmax from bolometric energy.

units_and_domain.weight: dimensionless; E^2*weight and b^-2 have energy-squared units
units_and_domain.kernel: real-valued, a.e. strongly measurable, and polynomially bounded by M E^n

acceptance: All six definitions and twelve exact semantic targets in the immutable interface compile against the source-bound IR import.
The actual right-sided limit, pointwise IR bound, explicit UV bound, radial integrability, and actual weighted product-measure kernel integrability are all present and distinct.
Both mixture and reference occupations satisfy the envelope under explicit probability, beta, eta, positivity, and integrability premises.
Final types and axioms are printed; only propext, Classical.choice, and Quot.sound are allowed.
No sorry, admit, custom axiom, unsafe declaration, formal-series-only shortcut, finite-energy-to-Tmax inference, or Fin7-to-all-ell promotion.
Exact argv, cwd, source/import/output hashes, exit, stdout/stderr, and first failures are retained.
Fresh Astra/ultra review checks endpoint direction, UV denominators, measurability, actual measures, both-state quantifiers, units, and scope.

tool_roles.lean: REQUIRED for the new real-analysis, measure, and envelope synthesis
tool_roles.wolfram_xact: NOT_NEEDED_NEW_EXECUTION: no tensor or geometry work; occupation conventions are frozen source inputs
tool_roles.sympy: NOT_NEEDED_NEW_EXECUTION: no new polynomial certificate; scalar inequalities are kernel checked

claim_ceiling.allowed: Conditional BE weight bounds and actual weighted-product-measure integrability for kernels with an a.e. single-monomial bound |K(E,omega)| <= M E^n, n:Nat, plus probability-mixture and independent-reference occupation envelopes under explicit beta/eta bounds.
excluded: measured Tmax or inferred common envelope from bolometric energy
a condensate atom or physical condensate-exclusion theorem
actual channel kernels not supplied by the contract

next_obligation: After independent review, adjudicate G12-D at the conditional analytic scope and continue the next dependency-safe node.
